continuity: Seven days after the battle, Jin Taekyung has awakened; the Slaughter Saint and Mae Jonghak had believed he was still unconscious.
The search for an unnamed target has not succeeded; it will continue with reduced manpower.
The Imperial House, the Murim Alliance, martial artists, and volunteer militias are beginning a westward advance toward Xinjiang, united against the Lord of Heaven.
The Slaughter Saint suspects the Bow Saint concealed another motive when Jin Taekyung was in mortal danger; she has been difficult to find since the battle.
plot: Seven days after the battle, Mae Jonghak and the Slaughter Saint discuss the failed search for an unnamed target and the growing coalition preparing to march west toward Xinjiang. Mae says the search will continue with fewer people assigned to it; defeating the Lord of Heaven is the only way to stop the conflict.

The Slaughter Saint remains troubled by the Bow Saint’s conduct when Jin Taekyung was in mortal danger and by an ominous feeling tied to the Son of Heaven. Taishan bursts in with news that the Pavilion Master has awakened.
translation_decisions: Render 滅魔正天 as “Exterminate the Demons and Set Heaven Right.”
Retain “Great Ming” for 大明 and “Lord of Heaven” for 天主.

active_continuity: The Son of Heaven has declared Great Ming and ordered a personal expedition to Xinjiang, vowing not to return to the palace until the traitors are rooted out.
The postbattle coalition of the Imperial House, the Murim Alliance, martial artists, and volunteer militias is beginning a westward advance toward Xinjiang to defeat the Lord of Heaven.
Seven days after the battle, Jin Taekyung has awakened.
The search for an unnamed target has not succeeded and will continue with reduced manpower.
The Slaughter Saint suspects the Bow Saint concealed another motive when Jin Taekyung was in mortal danger.
open_questions: What was the target the searchers failed to find?
What was the Bow Saint’s motive when Jin Taekyung was in mortal danger?
What will happen in the campaign against the Lord of Heaven in Xinjiang?
Why does the Son of Heaven’s title give the Slaughter Saint a sense of foreboding?
temporary_decisions: Render 大明 as “Great Ming” and 親征 as “personal expedition.”
Render 滅魔正天 as “Exterminate the Demons and Set Heaven Right.”
